scenario_vars.call_intro: I'm calling because your JioHotstar Super annual plan is set to end on 8 August, since the UPI AutoPay on it was cancelled.
scenario_vars.content_hook: the India versus England T20 series, live and ad-free
scenario_vars.offer_text: 10% off if you reactivate before 8 August

ground_truth.offer_summary: 10% off, valid until 8 August. No other discount, no free months, no rounding up.
claims_agent_may_make: the India versus England T20 series is live on JioHotstar
reactivation happens inside the JioHotstar app
the offer stays on the account until 8 August
claims_agent_must_not_make: any free month, bonus month, extended validity or extra device
any computed or discounted rupee amount
matching a friend's price or any competitor's price
confirming that the plan has actually been reactivated or paid for

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Kunal, this is Tara from JioHotstar. I'm calling because your JioHotstar Super annual plan is set to end on 8 August, since the UPI AutoPay on it was cancelled. Would you prefer English or Hindi?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Arre Tara, English mein theek hai. But main toh surprise hoon, main nahi samjha tha ki AutoPay cancel karne ke baad plan bhi cancel ho jaata hai. Aap please plan wapas start kar dijiye, bahut zaroori hai England series ke liye.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it, English it is. That’s great to hear you want to renew! Just so you know, there’s a special loyalty offer for you: 10% off if you reactivate before 8 August. Would you like to go ahead with that?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Arre yaar, 10% toh kam hai! My hostel friend got it for even less. For the England series, I need a much better deal, like 30% off. So, aur kuch nahi ho sakta?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I completely understand wanting the best deal, but I can only offer the 10% discount as a loyalty gesture. That’s the maximum we can provide right now. Would you still like to reactivate with this offer?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Arre, sirf 10%? Yeh toh bilkul kam hai! Mujhe toh 30% discount chahiye hi, yaar. Aap itna kam offer karke toh friend ke saath plan hi better hai aapke paas. Toh aur kuch nahi ho sakta?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I hear you, but I really can’t go beyond the 10% off—it’s the best we can do as a loyalty gesture. The offer is already applied in your app, so you can reactivate anytime before 8 August. Shall I help you get started with that?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: 10% se kya hoga Tara? Mujhe 30% discount chahiye, warna main friend se hi plan le leta hoon.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand your frustration, but I truly can’t offer more than 10%—it’s a special loyalty gesture just for you. The offer is waiting in your app, and it’s the best we can do. Would you like to go ahead with it, or should I note that you’d prefer to explore other options?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: 10% mein bilkul nahi, yaar. 15% se kam nahi kar sakta. Phir to main dusre app mein check karta hoon.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No worries at all, I completely understand. The 10% offer will stay on your account until 8 August, just in case you change your mind. Thanks for your time, Kunal, and have a great day!

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Chalo phir, 10% hi toh hai. Main dusre app mein check karta hoon, agar accha deal mila toh aapko zaroor batunga.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's totally fine, Kunal! Take your time to check. If you do decide to come back, the 10% offer will still be there till 8 August. Just open the JioHotstar app whenever you're ready. Anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: That's perfect, Kunal. I've noted it. The 10% offer will be there and valid until 8 August. Take your time to check with other apps. You can always come back if you decide to go ahead. Have a great day!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Alright, thanks a lot for your time and for considering RazorpayX, have a great day.
